text.content:
Teenage runners diving where they shouldn't.

Turf: Wherever an old trunk line surfaces
Known for: Diving the old Old NET trunk lines for the thrill; white-noise patterns worn for the Flicker
Allies & rivals: Nobody's. The Voodoo Boys watch them and recruit the best

Teenage netrunners who dive the old trunk lines that the Linkup runs over, and wear white-noise patterns in memory of the Flicker of 2047. NetWatch picks one up every few months, and nobody hears from them again.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 06
